Hi @Alex.Moya , I purchased this model on fab. I sent you an email I would really appreciate your response. My issue is that I work in UE 5 and I opened the prefab in Unity to export an FBX but the exported FBX from the prefab only gives a few animations. I just wanted to request the animations if you have the file available. I have exported the mesh and materials succesfully.

@SakuraNeha If you download the "source.zip" file, you'll download a model that has all the animations combined into one, and you'll have to separate them (I don't know how to do this in Unreal, but I know it's possible in Unity). To get all the animations, I recommend downloading the "lyndswrum_water.unitypackage" file, which has the animations separated, along with other extras. However, that file can only be opened in Unity, although once opened, you can transfer it to Unreal without any problems. Unity is free, by the way.

@Alex.Moya Hi, appreciate the response. Ah ok, now I understand what the source file on FAB contains. Sorry I am a bit of a beginner but yes, as you said I opened it in Unity and was able to export the animations by adding them to one of the prefabs, the model and animations look beautiful in UE5 . I increased the normal values and made its scales pop a bit more, it looks awesome with the realistic lighting and environment. Anyways, great artworks on these dragons/other creatures. I should have checked that it was a Unity Asset, but in the end I am happy it was worth it getting it into UE and I got some experience in Unity as well by learning a bit about it. Thank you :)

@Emerian I know and anyone who might see these models knows that they are generated by artificial intelligence and I agree with you if someone made them with 3D programs it would be more accurate and efficient but you are just stirring up dust my friend the models are free for those who want to use them science is developing and we must keep up with it in the past when the farmer was plowing the land with just a shovel his back almost broke from exhaustion so they invented the bulldozer and he was happy with this development but now you reject development and want to dig the land with a shovel stay alone

@aabdala853 That is a VERY BAD comparison, I am not rejecting development, I am not supporting AI Generated Content (Art, Models, Games etc).

AI is good for assisting with questions, simulations, predictions etc, maybe used for inspiration or to show how something "could look".
AI should not be "designing" stuff that requires Soul, Imagination and Improvisation while still keeping it true to reality in some way (aka keep proportions consistent).
AI can not do everything we humans do, and it should not, but the sad thing is that humanity sucks at using stuff for what it is good for, and we start using it for the wrong things like AI Scamming and fake content, THAT I reject, but not AI in general.

@Emerian This is your opinion, right or wrong. Do you want to force people to agree with your views? That's bigotry, my friend. Be open-minded. Neither you nor I invented artificial intelligence to determine the path of its development and the direction of its use. . Correct, what country are you from? If you like to answer or not, feel free to do so. Finally, I wish you a happy day.

I did not want to enforce this upon others, if that was implied then that is not what was intended, I am just stating my opinion.
